preconditions.description: The input must be a string.

postconditions.expression: return_value == 'In with a chance' if (any('+' in input and '44' in input, '07' in input) and all(c.isdigit() or c == '-' for c in input) and len([c for c in input if c != '-']) == 11 and (input.replace('-', '').startswith('+447') or input.replace('-', '').startswith('07'))) else return_value == 'Plenty more fish in the sea'
postconditions.description: If the input string, after removing all dashes, contains either '+44' followed by 10 digits or '07' followed by 9 digits, return 'In with a chance'. Otherwise, return 'Plenty more fish in the sea'.
